item.title: Middle East crisis rattles Indian stock market; list of big laggards
item.description: The Middle East conflict has sent crude oil prices soaring, severely impacting global financial markets, particularly India. The BSE Sensex plunged over 3200 points, with Nifty also dropping 520.45 points over the last five days.

item.description: The incident took place when Maheshwari was travelling from Jaipur to Mathura on a religious trip. Near milestone 136.8 in the Raini police station area, his BMW went out of control. It broke the barricades, and the median before crashing into a culvert wall.

item.title: Could blockade of Strait of Hormuz trigger oil shock bigger than 1973: Here are the likely impacts
item.description: The blocking of the Strait of Hormuz would lead to supply chain disruptions in the oil markets globally. The Strait handles almost 20 million barrels of oil flow everyday and its closure would severely impact oil flow and also the prices in the market. This would be worse than the oil shocks the world witnessed during the Islamic Revolution in 1973 and the Yom Kippur War.

item.title: Excise policy case: Delhi HC stays action against CBI officer, halts ED trial for now
item.description: The Delhi High Court has dramatically intervened in the Delhi excise policy case, staying departmental action against a lead CBI investigating officer and pausing related ED proceedings.

item.title: Can sugar make your kids short-tempered? Study finds a link between diet & behaviour
item.description: When children were three, caregivers completed a detailed questionnaire regarding their eating habits. The foods were then segregated using the NOVA system, which classifies items according to the level of processing.

item.description: Sanju Samson, hailing from Kerala’s coastal town of Vizhinjam, has brought immense pride through his exceptional performance in the tournament, the state’s General Education and Labour minister V Sivankutty said while announcing the decision.

item.title: Numbers don’t lie! Incredible stats behind India’s unrivalled white-ball dominance
item.description: India secured their third T20 World Cup in 2026, making history as the first team to win three titles, defend the championship, and triumph on home soil. This victory, alongside numerous shattered records, underscores India’s unparalleled white-ball cricket dominance. Since 2024, India has clinched six world titles across men’s, women’s, and age-level cricket, aiming for all three ICC trophies simultaneously by 2027.
